topics.title: Celebrity Gay Rumors & Activist Pressure
topics.summary: This broadcast discusses circulating rumors about numerous celebrities being gay, fueled by magazine reports and speculation. Individuals named include zany dom del louise, Johnny Matthes, Rob Lowe, George Michael, Richard Carpenter, Mike Tyson, Robin Givens, Veronica Hamill, Linda Evans, peewee herman, and others. Activist groups like ACT UP push for LGBTQ+ visibility in entertainment while columnist Liz Smith’s alleged lesbian relationships add another layer to the discussion.

topics.title: Liz Smith and Phone Call Chaos
topics.summary: During a bizarre phone call, the host discusses an outlandish scenario involving Liz Smith’s physical attributes and attempts to solicit feedback from listeners. The conversation veers into uncomfortable territory with graphic descriptions of her body and culminates in confusing conference calls with hot tub Johnnie and Richard Simmons.”}id: 1234567890

topics.title: Phone Calls and a Mysterious Movie Guest
topics.summary: The host attempts to reach Dave and Jackie for calls but struggles due to their reluctance. He then engages in a bizarre conversation with a mystery guest, sounding like Marlon Brando, discussing recent movies, attempting to identify them through vague clues, and ultimately revealing himself as Richard Harris from ‘A Man Called Horse’.

topics.title: Tax Discussions & Bahamas Mishaps
topics.summary: Richard Harris discusses his tax situation living in the Bahamas versus Ireland/America, highlighting the lack of taxes in the former. He recounts an incident on ‘The Field’ set where co-star John Hurt became excessively drunk, singing songs and attempting a striptease, creating awkwardness for the cast and crew.

topics.title: Richard Harris Discusses "The Field"
topics.summary: Actor Richard Harris discusses his role in the film "The Field," a story about an Irish farmer who rents a field his family has worked for generations before an American buyer purchases it for marijuana cultivation. Harris explains the film's metaphorical meaning about life's struggles and his process of memorizing dialogue for the lead role.

topics.title: Richard Harris Interview and Comedy Sketches
topics.summary: Radio host interviews actor Richard Harris about his film "The Field" and discusses his celebrity connections. The segment includes comedy sketches featuring William Shatner singing and a presidential impersonation, followed by discussion of Mayor Dinkins' efforts to bring the Grammy Awards back to New York.
